what: A photo slot inside a horizontally flowing band — from when the slot enters at the right edge of the screen until it leaves at the left (progress p = (screen width − cell left) ÷ (screen width + cell width)) the inner image is pushed left by −25%×(1 − p) and catches up to 0 — tied directly to scroll, no curve. look: fade — once the cell’s left edge comes within 200px of the screen’s right edge, it appears once with a 1s ease-out. On narrow screens (below 1025) there is no push, it appears when the cell top rises 100px above the screen bottom

options.[data-fx-part=img]: Inner image that gets pushed (child), or the first child if none — place it wider than the cell (e.g. width 125%) so no empty gap shows
options.max: Max push (%), default 25 — original cells use 10·15·30
options.look: If fade, it appears on entry (starts transparent in css)
options.at: Appearance position — cell’s left edge within this many px (default 200) of the screen’s right edge
options.at-y: On narrow screens, how many px above the screen bottom the cell top sits, default 100
options.wide: Minimum width (px) for the horizontal strip, default 1025
options.--fx-dur / --fx-ease: Appearance duration and curve (css), default 1s · ease-out

note: Attach it inside a horizontal band like pin-horizontal. It measures by window scroll events, so it can be used together with Lenis and ScrollTrigger

from.where: index.html .pa-photo — original about.js .parallax-img (data-max 10·15·25·30, translateX(-max×(1−p)%)) and .js-fadeIn (is-active when left ≤ width − 200, on phones top ≤ height − 100)
